There are a couple of ways to do this. You can use Android Auto for a seamless experience on your car's display, or you can simply connect your phone to your car's Bluetooth.

  • To use Android Auto, you'll need to make sure your car and phone are compatible. Then, you can connect your phone via a USB cable or wirelessly through Bluetooth, and Android Auto should start automatically.
  • To use Bluetooth, go to the Bluetooth settings on both your car and your phone and pair them as you would with any other device.

Once connected, you can use voice commands with "Hey Google" to navigate, play music, make calls, and more.
